es: Si viviera en el Caribe, nadaría todos los días.

es: Si fuera pescador, saldría al mar antes del amanecer.

en: If the road were shorter, we would arrive before lunch.

en: If I lived near the sea, I wouldn't need a vacation.

en: If I could paint, I would paint the sea at Santa Marta.

en: If the beach were ours, we wouldn't let anyone in.

en: If I could stay one more night, I would watch the stars from the sand.

es: Si no hubiera nubes, veríamos todas las estrellas.
en: If there were no clouds, we would see all the stars.

en: If Rosa were alive, the building wouldn't be for sale.

es: Si Joaquín estuviera vivo, Yesid tendría con quién hablar de todo esto.
en: If Joaquín were alive, Yesid would have someone to talk to about all this.

es: Si Joaquín estuviera vivo, sentiría vergüenza por todo esto.

en: If Yesid had his own boat, he wouldn't work for anyone.

en: If Tomás spoke better Spanish, he would understand the fishermen.

en: If Tomás weren't so shy, he would say something to Vale tonight.

en: If Tomás could, he would stay in Taganga for good.

en: If Hernando were young, he would travel with us.

en: If Vale had her own business, she would open at five in the morning.

en: If Vale weren't here, the café wouldn't work.

en: If Simón could really talk, he would say terrible things about Altamira.

en: If Simón understood what he says, he wouldn't say that.

en: If the final stage were easy, we wouldn't be afraid.
